Essential codebase maintenance including dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, and documentation
Community support including issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback-driven enhancements, and public communication
AI-friendly documentation and integration resources for AI-driven development workflows

request.recipient: Intersect 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Dolos by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Dolos maintenance and enhancement plus a 15,750 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.
The motivation states that 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve will fund a part-time Dolos maintainer for 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
Dolos is described as a lightweight Cardano data node written in Rust that provides chain-data access through multiple query interfaces without running a traditional full node.
The proposal claims Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.

The maintainer scope includes dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixes, documentation, issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback enhancements, public communication, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.

The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal asserts that the requested amount did not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.

The proposal states that oversight costs are included in the administration fee and that Intersect plus technically capable third parties will provide reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, plus 2025 Intersect maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC that is being delivered on schedule.

The proposal says Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, external oversight entities, threshold-signature permissions, and a public dashboard for auditing and on-chain verification.

summary: The proposal seeks 540,750 ADA for a 12-month Dolos maintenance program run by TxPipe and administered by Intersect, with the document providing budget breakdown, work scope, governance-process references, smart-contract addresses, and oversight structure.
